report:
Based on comprehensive tracking of CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog updates throughout October 2026, a total of 36 CVEs were added to the list during this period [[12]](https://varaxontech.com/guides/cisa-kev-report-october-2026)[[20]](https://varaxontech.com/guides/cisa-kev-report-october-2026)[[22]](https://theuptimereport.com/cisa-known-exploited-vulnerabilities-analysis-2026/). These entries reflect confirmed evidence of active exploitation in the wild, with many carrying accelerated 3-day federal remediation deadlines under BOD 26-04 [[12]](https://varaxontech.com/guides/cisa-kev-report-october-2026)[[64]](https://varaxontech.com/guides/cisa-kev-report-october-2026). Below is the complete chronological list of the vulnerabilities, along with their respective vendors and affected products.

### October 1, 2026
- **CVE-2026-104286** — Fortinet, FortiMail: A critical unauthenticated arbitrary file write vulnerability combining path traversal and improper NULL-byte handling [[128]](https://labs.cloudsecurityalliance.org/research/csa-research-note-fortimail-zero-day-cve-2026-104286-2026100/)[[129]](https://securityarsenal.com/blog/cve-2026-104286-fortinet-fortimail-unauthenticated-arbitrary-file-write-under-active-exploitation-detection-and-remediation-guide).

### October 2, 2026
- **CVE-2026-102489** — Zammad GmbH, Zammad: A session fixation vulnerability in the open-source ticketing platform [[79]](https://securityarsenal.com/blog/cisa-kev-alert-zammad-cve-2026-102489-and-cve-2026-102490-session-fixation-and-privilege-escalation-under-active-exploitation).
- **CVE-2026-102490** — Zammad GmbH, Zammad: An improper privilege management flaw enabling local privilege escalation to root [[79]](https://securityarsenal.com/blog/cisa-kev-alert-zammad-cve-2026-102489-and-cve-2026-102490-session-fixation-and-privilege-escalation-under-active-exploitation)[[81]](https://www.tenable.com/cve/CVE-2026-102489).

### October 4, 2026
- **CVE-2026-88779** — Citrix, NetScaler: A zero-day vulnerability affecting NetScaler ADC and Gateway [[144]](https://shattered.io/at/citrix-netscaler-zero-day-cve-2026-88779/).

### October 8, 2026
- **CVE-2015-3306** — ProFTPD, ProFTPD: The legacy `mod_copy` vulnerability [[143]](https://datawater.com/cisa-kev-china-linked-legacy-vulnerabilities/)[[145]](http://www.vulnerability-lookup.org/2026/11/04/vulnerability-report-october-2026/).
- **CVE-2015-5477** — ISC, BIND: A TKEY vulnerability in BIND DNS software [[142]](https://eastbaycyber.com/kev/added/2026-10-08/)[[145]](http://www.vulnerability-lookup.org/2026/11/04/vulnerability-report-october-2026/).
- **CVE-2016-3081** — Apache, Struts: The Apache Struts Dynamic Method Invocation (DMI) vulnerability [[143]](https://datawater.com/cisa-kev-china-linked-legacy-vulnerabilities/)[[145]](http://www.vulnerability-lookup.org/2026/11/04/vulnerability-report-october-2026/).
- **CVE-2021-3199** — ONLYOFFICE, Docs: An actively exploited flaw in ONLYOFFICE Docs [[142]](https://eastbaycyber.com/kev/added/2026-10-08/)[[145]](http://www.vulnerability-lookup.org/2026/11/04/vulnerability-report-october-2026/).
- **CVE-2023-22894** — Strapi, Strapi: A vulnerability in the Strapi headless CMS [[142]](https://eastbaycyber.com/kev/added/2026-10-08/)[[145]](http://www.vulnerability-lookup.org/2026/11/04/vulnerability-report-october-2026/).

### October 13, 2026
- **CVE-2026-96951** — Microsoft, Windows: A command injection vulnerability [[90]](https://securityarsenal.com/blog/cisa-kev-alert-cve-2026-96951-windows-command-injection-and-cve-2026-104935-ivanti-connect-secure-auth-bypass-detection-and-remediation-guide).
- **CVE-2026-104935** — Ivanti, Connect Secure: An authentication bypass via spoofing vulnerability [[90]](https://securityarsenal.com/blog/cisa-kev-alert-cve-2026-96951-windows-command-injection-and-cve-2026-104935-ivanti-connect-secure-auth-bypass-detection-and-remediation-guide).

### October 15, 2026
